title: FOOD-005G — Customer/contact/consent domain
purpose: Pure private customer relationship, purpose-specific communication assertion and exact historical order-contact association; independent concepts, no runtime authority.

contract.customer: FoodCustomerVersion { id, version, account?: { principalId }, contact? }. food-customer identity. Reuse pure PrincipalId parser/type. Account shape association does not prove persistence, authentication, ownership or permissions. Optional account must stay identical across revisions, including absence; linking/relinking deferred.
contract.contact: FoodContactSnapshot { displayName?, email?, phone? }; at least one supplied field. Nonempty unpadded text, max UTF-16 lengths 200/320/64 respectively. Preserve exact representation; no lowercase, punctuation removal, deliverability/ownership claim or semantic email/phone validation.
contract.consent: FoodContactConsentVersion { id, version, purpose, target, status, evidence }. food-contact-consent identity. Purpose order-service or marketing; target exactly email channel/email or sms channel/phone. Status granted, denied or revoked; absence is not an unknown assertion. Evidence sourceReference (512 characters) and supplied occurredOn via validateFoodReviewDate.
contract.consentRevision: Same identity, purpose and exact target/channel/contact; consecutive version; explicit replacement status and evidence. No copying, current selection or legal-sufficiency claim. Repeated evidence values permitted; domain cannot authenticate freshness.
contract.marketing: Absence of a marketing grant means marketing is not granted. Customer/account/contact/order existence and order-service grant never imply marketing. A historical grant is not a current send permission; operative version/suppression policy deferred.
contract.association: FoodOrderContactAssociationVersion { id, version, order { id, version }, customer?: { id, version }, contact }. food-order-contact-association identity. Guest capture requires no customer/account. Contact independently copied, need not equal customer contact.
contract.sources: AgainstSources validates canonical exact physical-order snapshot and optional exact customer snapshot. Customer reference requires matching supplied customer; guest rejects unused customer source. Local validation does not establish remote existence/access. Initial association validates sources; structural revisions may replace customer/contact explicitly and must subsequently use AgainstSources for source reconciliation.
contract.associationRevision: Stable identity and exact order ID/version, consecutive version; explicit customer/contact replacement or omission. Earlier versions detached/frozen; later order/customer changes do not retarget them. Never mutate FOOD-005E.
contract.identityVersion: Explicit branded identities with prescribed distinct prefixes, local nonempty unpadded text <=128 UTF-16 characters and no colon. No generated IDs. Positive safe integers; initial helpers require 1; consecutive helpers reject overflow. Historical structural validators do not claim durable uniqueness.
contract.immutability: Strict own-key allowlists including symbols; detached frozen outer/nested snapshots. No retained caller-owned objects or cross-call state.
contract.privacy: Contact data private; never change public menu/static content/analytics/impact projections. Contact != fulfillment location != account login != customer identity != payment identity. Matching contact strings imply neither same person nor deduplication, account linkage, consent or rewards.
contract.purity: No clock, randomness, environment, IO, provider/session/authentication runtime, persistence or message delivery. Only supplied date validation.

operations: Exactly three new authorized files; synthetic fixtures only. No staging, commit/push, production access, provider communication or deployment.
